cross_class_invariants.target: 100/100 input permutations produce identical canonical report bytes
100% of mass, SOC/energy, power, charge-window and safety blockers have negative controls that are observed as blocked
100% of physical claims include configuration ID, source/raw data reference, timestamp, method, calibration/uncertainty and reviewer
100% of comparisons declare wheel/battery/charger/site boundaries and avoid double-counting direct-supply or regenerative energy
Report complete and failed missions, all missed service windows and unserved tasks; never exclude failures from denominators
